rud2006.authors: Rud, D., Schmietendorf, A., Dumke, R.
rud2006.title: Product metrics for service-oriented infrastructures
rud2006.note: Origin of AIS, ADS and ACS. The attribution and the ACS = AIS x ADS definition were confirmed against Panichella, Rahman and Taibi, Structural Coupling for Microservices (arXiv:2103.04674), which cites Rud et al. for them; the URL points there rather than at a paywalled proceedings copy.

perepletchikov2007.authors: Perepletchikov, M., Ryan, C., Frampton, K., Tari, Z.
perepletchikov2007.title: Coupling Metrics for Predicting Maintainability in Service-Oriented Designs
perepletchikov2007.note: The systematic treatment of coupling in service-oriented design that system-level density metrics sit inside.

abreu1996.authors: Brito e Abreu, F., Melo, W.
abreu1996.title: Evaluating the impact of object-oriented design on software quality
abreu1996.note: The MOOD suite, whose Coupling Factor has the same actual-over-possible-couplings shape SCF uses. SCF inherits its criticisms too.

bogner2017.authors: Bogner, J., Wagner, S., Zimmermann, A.
bogner2017.title: Automatically measuring the maintainability of service- and microservice-based systems
bogner2017.note: Collects the service-oriented maintainability metrics, AIS and ADS among them, and is where their microservice-era reuse is argued.

bogner2020.authors: Bogner, J., Wagner, S., Zimmermann, A.
bogner2020.title: Collecting Service-Based Maintainability Metrics from RESTful API Descriptions: Static Analysis and Threshold Derivation
bogner2020.note: Directly relevant to DD-006: derives metric thresholds empirically from a corpus of systems rather than asserting them, which is the stronger version of what derive_thresholds.py does over three subjects.

taibi2018.title: On the Definition of Microservice Bad Smells
taibi2018.note: The reference catalogue of microservice bad smells, including shared persistence, cyclic dependency and megaservice, derived from practitioner interviews.

neri2020.authors: Neri, D., Soldani, J., Zimmermann, O., Brogi, A.
neri2020.title: Design principles, architectural smells and refactorings for microservices: a multivocal review
neri2020.note: Pairs each smell with the refactorings that resolve it, which is what a counterfactual explanation has to produce to be actionable.

freeman1977.title: A Set of Measures of Centrality Based on Betweenness
freeman1977.note: The definition of betweenness, and the normalisation by the number of ordered pairs a node can sit between.

brandes2001.title: A faster algorithm for betweenness centrality
brandes2001.note: The algorithm implemented in metrics/aam4j_metrics/graph.py, which is what makes betweenness affordable to recompute on every snapshot.

rudin2019.title: Stop explaining black box machine learning models for high stakes decisions and use interpretable models instead
rudin2019.note: The position P5 and DD-007 rest on: prefer a model whose decisions decompose over an explanation layered onto one whose do not.

lundberg2017.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
lundberg2017.note: SHAP, the attribution method planned for the gradient-boosted arm. Its estimates carry sampling error; the linear baseline's attributions do not, which is why the linear model comes first.

jia2011.title: An Analysis and Survey of the Development of Mutation Testing
jia2011.venue: IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 37(5), pp. 649-678
jia2011.note: The mutation-testing tradition DD-008 borrows from. The borrowing is analogical: those operators mutate code to test a test suite, these mutate an architecture to label a dataset, and the distribution objection applies to the second in a way it does not to the first.

kapoor2023.title: Leakage and the reproducibility crisis in machine-learning-based science
kapoor2023.note: The survey behind P2 and P3. It catalogues the leakage types that produce irreproducible results across fields, including train-test contamination through preprocessing fitted on all the data.
